Theodore J Kaczynski (Technological Slavery, p 63+71)
>´´Notwithstanding the folly or Ray Kurzweil’s fantasies of a future technological utopia, he is absolutely right about some thing. And (ii) they "intuitively assume that the current rate of progress will continue for future periods," neglecting the unending acceleration of technological development...
